function.description: Get security advisories results trend over time. The default sort is by scan time descending.
function.name: api_getSecurityAdvisoriesResultsTrendOverTime

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

scanTime.description: Return advisories trend with scanTime greater than this scanTime

criticalSecurityImpactRatingAdvisoriesCo.description: Number of advisories which have a security impact rating of critical

highSecurityImpactRatingAdvisoriesCount.description: Number of advisories which have a security impact rating of high
